name: TAJ MAHAL
description: A timeless symbol of love and one of the Seven Wonders of the World, crafted in pure white marble.

name: AJANTA CAVES
description: Ancient Buddhist rock-cut cave monuments famous for masterpiece mural paintings and sculptures dating from the 2nd century BCE.

name: AMER FORT
description: A majestic example of Rajput architecture and royal grandeur overlooking Maota Lake in Jaipur.

name: KONARK SUN TEMPLE
description: A 13th-century monumental chariot temple dedicated to the Sun God Surya, celebrated for intricate stone carvings.

name: QUTUB MINAR
description: The world's tallest brick minaret standing at 72.5 meters, surrounded by ancient medieval ruins and epigraphs.

name: HAMPI
description: Ruins of the glorious Vijayanagara Empire, featuring monolithic sculptures, stone chariots, and boulder-strewn temples.
